remarks: Welcome to 174 Continental Drive!  This beautiful 1964 square ft., two story Colonial offers four bedrooms, and 1-1/2 bathrooms.   This thoughtfully designed living space also has an attached three season room, which leads to a 14x18 composite deck providing an ideal setting for entertaining, dining, or simply enjoying your nearly 1/2-acre lot.  A custom awning is a feature of the deck allowing protection from the sun and rain.  The backyard is truly an extension of the living space, featuring an above ground pool.  A shed completes the backyard for housing lawn and pool equipment. The partially finished basement, constructed with poured concrete walls, offers additional versatility. The basement is partially finished offering a perfect size playroom or office. A unique feature in this home is that there is a direct access to the basement from the two-car garage and also from the kitchen.  the oversized garage offers convenient storage and ample parking.  The concrete driveway allows plenty of room to park vehicles for family and guests.  The upstairs offers four large bedrooms, and the owner's bedroom shows a nice sized walk-in closet.  The upstairs bathroom is very large with two closets for storage. An air-conditioning unit has been installed in the attic which offers forced air cooling on the upper floor throughout the summer. This home has been owned and meticulously maintained by one family for over 40 years! Located in a highly desirable neighborhood, in close proximity to little league, bowling, and Skateland for recreational activities. This attractive Colonial combines classic style, comfortable living spaces and excellent outdoor amenities.   This is a wonderful opportunity to make this well-maintained home your own!! Dining room set, couch in basement can be negotiated. Ring doorbells will stay.  Range in basement can remain as well.
